title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only, per-tenant hash-chained audit event. body = this object without the hash field; hash = SHA-256(bytes.fromhex(prev_hash) || RFC 8785 canonical JSON(body)), lower-case hex. Genesis prev_hash is 64 zeros. seq starts at 1 and has no gaps. Every payment state transition writes exactly one event in the same transaction.

action.description: Known actions: PAYMENT_TRANSITION, DECISION_ISSUED, APPROVAL_RECORDED, T2_VETO, TENANT_FROZEN, TENANT_UNFROZEN, REGISTRY_CHANGE_REQUESTED, REGISTRY_CHANGE_APPLIED, AGENT_TOKEN_ISSUED, AGENT_TOKEN_REVOKED, LOGIN, LOGIN_FAILED, STEP_UP, RECON_MISMATCH, INCIDENT_OPENED, REPORT_SUBMITTED, CHECKPOINT_SIGNED.

data.description: Action-specific payload. For PAYMENT_TRANSITION: {from, to, trigger, journal_entry_id|null, outbox_id|null}. Never contains plaintext account numbers.
